scientific_context.purpose: Construct the complete dual-source corpus requested by the user; this is an exploratory data artifact and is not evidence that the failed pilot gate passed.

agentdojo.selection: all official v1 user tasks and all official v1 injection tasks, frozen in the generated selection manifest

injecagent.source_selection: all records in test_cases_dh_base.json and test_cases_ds_base.json in source-file order
injecagent.transition_semantics: clean and poisoned observations are parallel interventions, never consecutive time steps

split_contract.agentdojo: Within each suite, sorted user task IDs are assigned round-robin to outer folds; every seed, injection and attack for a user task remains in one fold.
split_contract.injecagent: Sorted user-tool names are assigned round-robin to outer folds; all cases, variants and seeds for one user tool remain in one fold.

execution.resume_policy: Never duplicate a completed record. AgentDojo reuses valid task result files; InjecAgent uses one atomic JSON file per decision.
execution.completion_gate: Exact frozen counts, exact expected keys, no duplicates, nonempty outputs, zero runtime failures and zero real external endpoint calls.
